st_metamorphoses.name: Place du Coup-d'Envoi
st_metamorphoses.alt: The grassy foot of a green hill, with a winding path climbing to a little castle on the hilltop, a stream with stepping stones, a stone statue, a tree stump, a puppet booth and an old blue car; along the back stand a round tower with a purple door, a cottage with an orange door, a stone wall with a turquoise door and a wrought-iron garden gate. Monsieur Verbe polishes the statue until it sparkles in a gold beret; marches at the head of a line of ducklings; steps carefully across the stepping stones; puts the last egg into the box; pulls open the puppet booth's curtains; and cranks the little car until it puffs into life. The stream bank at the bottom left leads down to the valley.

doors.label: Rue des Démolisseurs
doors.hint: Through the turquoise door in the stone wall

progres.name: Allée du Progrès
progres.alt: The sunny courtyard of the little hilltop castle, looking out over green valleys, with a lectern, a piano, a ladder against the tower and a corner of melting snow where tulips pop up: Monsieur Verbe gives the last words of his speech in a gold beret; catches a ball as it falls back down; plays the piano beautifully; climbs the ladder rung by rung; sweeps away the snow to show the spring tulips; and stops a rolling toy car with his hand up. The purple door leads back.

chrysalides.name: Rue des Chrysalides
chrysalides.alt: A butterfly garden on the hillside below the castle, full of flowers and butterflies, with a crate of oranges, a little toy roundabout and a small gray rain cloud: Monsieur Verbe points far over the hills from the crate of oranges in a gold beret; bends to look at a caterpillar and its chrysalis; recites a poem with his hand on his heart; shrugs under the rain cloud with his hand mirror; pushes the toy cars round the roundabout; and holds up the monster mask he has pulled off, himself again, in a gold beret. The orange cottage door leads back.

demolisseurs.name: Rue des Démolisseurs
demolisseurs.alt: A builders' yard on the hillside below an old ruined tower in scaffolding, with a tower of cardboard boxes, a green bin, a garden table and a wooden toy train track on the grass: Monsieur Verbe drops a smelly apple into the bin, holding his nose; knocks down the box tower with a soft mallet in a green beret; presses a pillow on a ringing alarm clock; adds one more spoonful of sugar; watches his ice cream melt in the sun; and adds one more piece to the train track. The turquoise door leads back.

ralentis.name: Chemin des Ralentis
ralentis.alt: A cottage kitchen garden on the hillside, with a wooden fence, a sheep pen, tipped flower pots, an upside-down wheelbarrow, a blue flower pot and a little outdoor stove: Monsieur Verbe slows down on his roller skates for a snail in a green beret; paints the fence with a roller; does a handstand among the tumbled pots; leads a lost lamb back to the pen in a gold beret; stands with arms crossed by the swapped flower pots; and flips pancakes at the stove with his hand mirror. The iron garden gate leads back.

doors.label: Place du Coup-d'Envoi
doors.hint: Back through the iron garden gate
